name: Mahou Shoujo Pastel ☆ Hearts ~Pastel ☆ Peach Ingoku Jutairoku~
original_name: 魔法少女パステル☆ハーツ ~パステル☆ピーチ淫獄受胎録~
source:
The Magic Stone... 
The source of infinite magic power only designated to the chosen ones.
The bearers of pure hearts, "Magical Girl Pastel*Hearts" are selected by the stone.
Ruria Tachibana is empowered as one of the team, the "Pastel*Peach".

She protects the people from the venomous fangs of the invaders 
together with her close friend Kanami Shinonome, the "Pastel*Mint".

These transforming heroines are blessed with unequaled strength,
the destined defeat steadily draws near to them though......!

Once being defeated, the magical girl is violated...
What fate will she follow afterwards...!?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE209750.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
魔法石……

只会将无限魔力赋予被选中者的源泉。
拥有纯洁心灵的“魔法少女Pastel*Hearts”由魔法石选出。
立花露莉亚获得力量，成为团队成员“Pastel*Peach”。

她与亲密好友东云香奈美——“Pastel*Mint”——一起，保护人们免受侵略者毒牙的侵害。

这些变身英雄拥有无可匹敌的力量，
然而注定的败北正一步步向她们逼近……！

魔法少女一旦战败，就会遭到侵犯……
她将迎来怎样的命运……！？

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE209750.html]DLsite English[/url]）
